_question: Do gradient-12 molecules show anomalous per-epoch training dynamics (late convergence, oscillation, plateau-then-drift) vs a matched sample from certain-47?
result: NOT LOGGED - the check cannot be answered from existing artifacts; requires a new instrumented training run

per_epoch_aggregate_val_mae_rmse.source: aqm-spice2/aqm-spice2/freesolv_ft.log (original cross-validation run, folds 0-4) and stdout-only prints in deep_ensemble.py train_member (seed runs)
per_epoch_aggregate_val_mae_rmse.granularity: single scalar per epoch pooled over ALL 102 validation molecules (e.g. 'Epoch 59 | Val MAE: 0.511')
per_epoch_aggregate_val_mae_rmse.useful_for: global convergence behavior only; CANNOT be decomposed to per-molecule trajectories because predictions per epoch were neither stored nor logged

checkpoints.granularity: ONE checkpoint per run (best-val epoch only), selected inside the source code (torch.save only on best-val improvement)
checkpoints.useful_for: no per-epoch snapshots exist, so no trajectory can be reconstructed by reloading intermediate weights

final_outputs.seed_42/metrics.json, predictions.csv, p: final-epoch (best-val ckpt) predictions only; no time axis

epoch_history_csv_files.columns: epoch, task_mse_train_eV2, l_nbr_raw_eV2, l_nbr_used, var_p_eV2, n_active
epoch_history_csv_files.caveat: different experiment family (neighbor-regularization ablation, not the Stage-3 fine-tune), aggregate train losses only, not per molecule; cannot serve as a proxy for Stage-3 per-molecule trajectories

what_exists.tensorboard: no tfevents files anywhere under aqm-spice2

code_evidence.cv_finetune.py: per-epoch loop prints pooled val MAE/RMSE only; best-val checkpoint saved once
code_evidence.deep_ensemble.py: train_member prints per-epoch pooled val MAE; torch.save only best-val state_dict; no per-molecule loss accumulation or CSV writing during training

conclusion: Per-epoch, per-molecule predictions or losses were never logged during Stage 3 fine-tuning (neither the original cv run nor the 5-seed ensemble run). A training-dynamics comparison between gradient-12 and certain-47 therefore cannot be performed. Reconstructing it would require an instrumented re-run (log per-molecule losses/predictions each epoch, or checkpoint every epoch) - this was NOT done here, per protocol: no retraining to reconstruct.
